A soft vertical edge, with every row the same, so the Sobel magnitude is 4 times the difference of the two horizontal neighbors. The table shows it clipped at 255. At x = 31 it is 4 x (162 - 50) = 448, and at x = 32 it is 4 x (205 - 93) = 448. The gradient points along x, so each pixel is compared with its left and right neighbors. These two pixels form the top of the ridge and keep their value. The rest become 0.
